% fig_regime_map: outcome over (sigma/R, viscosity) with time-to-ignition.
% Data: fig_regime_map/regime_points.csv (regenerated by
% scripts/p019_sigma_procedure.py figures) + fig_margin_curve/scales.csv.
% Design: y = revolutions to ignition (log); ignited runs plot at their
% onset; survivors plot in the labeled "no ignition" band at top; runs
% still in flight (pending01=1) are excluded by filter and appear when the
% CSV regenerates.  COLOR = viscosity; SHAPE = startup class (circle
% screen / square production); FILL: filled = ignited, open = survivor.
% NT=72/144 off-dt points share the marker and are annotated in the
% caption via the provenance appendix.  Compile: pdflatex (from this dir).
\documentclass[tikz]{standalone}
\usepackage{pgfplots}
\pgfplotsset{compat=1.17}
\definecolor{cinv}{HTML}{0072B2}   % inviscid (Okabe-Ito blue)
\definecolor{cvis}{HTML}{D55E00}   % viscous  (Okabe-Ito vermillion)
\definecolor{cref}{HTML}{707070}
\pgfplotsset{
  discard if not/.style 2 args={
    x filter/.append code={%
      \edef\tempa{\thisrow{#1}}\edef\tempb{#2}%
      \ifx\tempa\tempb\else\def\pgfmathresult{nan}\fi
    }
  },
}
% ignited points: \ripts{screen01}{viscous01}{style}
\newcommand\ripts[3]{%
  \addplot+[only marks, forget plot, #3,
    discard if not={pending01}{0},
    discard if not={ignited01}{1},
    discard if not={screen01}{#1},
    discard if not={viscous01}{#2}]
    table[col sep=comma, x=sigma_over_R, y=t_ign_rev]
    {fig_regime_map/regime_points.csv};}
% survivor points, plotted in the top band at fixed y: \rspts{...}{y}{style}
\newcommand\rspts[4]{%
  \addplot+[only marks, forget plot, #4,
    discard if not={pending01}{0},
    discard if not={ignited01}{0},
    discard if not={screen01}{#1},
    discard if not={viscous01}{#2}]
    table[col sep=comma, x=sigma_over_R, y expr=#3]
    {fig_regime_map/regime_points.csv};}
\pgfplotstableread[col sep=comma]{fig_margin_curve/scales.csv}\scales
\pgfplotstablegetelem{1}{value}\of\scales \let\vSEQ\pgfplotsretval
\pgfplotstablegetelem{2}{value}\of\scales \let\vSSTAB\pgfplotsretval
\pgfplotstablegetelem{3}{value}\of\scales \let\vSZERO\pgfplotsretval
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[
  width=12.2cm, height=8.0cm,
  xmode=log, ymode=log,
  xmin=0.012, xmax=0.11, ymin=2, ymax=110,
  xtick={0.015,0.02,0.03,0.05,0.08},
  xticklabels={0.015,0.02,0.03,0.05,0.08},
  ytick={2,5,10,20,40},
  yticklabels={2,5,10,20,40},
  unbounded coords=discard,
  xlabel={core size $\sigma/R$},
  ylabel={revolutions to ignition},
  grid=major, grid style={cref!25, very thin},
  axis line style={cref!70},
  tick label style={font=\small}, label style={font=\small},
  legend style={font=\footnotesize, at={(0.985,0.015)}, anchor=south east,
    legend cell align=left, draw=cref!50, fill=white, fill opacity=0.9,
    text opacity=1, row sep=-1pt},
]
% --- "no ignition" band (survivors), above the separator ---
\fill[cref!8] (axis cs:0.012,55) rectangle (axis cs:0.11,110);
\draw[cref, thin] (axis cs:0.012,55) -- (axis cs:0.11,55);
\node[font=\scriptsize, text=cref, anchor=west]
  at (axis cs:0.0125,90) {no ignition (survived full run)};
% --- initializer scales ---
\draw[cref, dash dot, thin]
  (axis cs:\vSEQ,2) -- (axis cs:\vSEQ,110)
  node[pos=0.06, above right, rotate=90, font=\scriptsize, text=cref]
  {$\sigma_{eq}$};
\draw[cref, dash dot, thin]
  (axis cs:\vSSTAB,2) -- (axis cs:\vSSTAB,110)
  node[pos=0.06, above right, rotate=90, font=\scriptsize, text=cref]
  {$\sigma_{stab}$};
\draw[black, dash dot, semithick]
  (axis cs:\vSZERO,2) -- (axis cs:\vSZERO,110)
  node[pos=0.06, above right, rotate=90, font=\scriptsize]
  {$\sigma_0=2\sigma_{eq}$};
% --- ignited: at (sigma, t_ign_rev) ---
\ripts{1}{0}{mark=*, mark size=2.6pt,
  mark options={draw=cinv, fill=cinv, line width=0.6pt}}
\ripts{1}{1}{mark=*, mark size=2.6pt,
  mark options={draw=cvis, fill=cvis, line width=0.6pt}}
\ripts{0}{0}{mark=square*, mark size=2.4pt,
  mark options={draw=cinv, fill=cinv, line width=0.6pt}}
\ripts{0}{1}{mark=square*, mark size=2.4pt,
  mark options={draw=cvis, fill=cvis, line width=0.6pt}}
% --- survivors: in the band (screen y=65, production y=85) ---
\rspts{1}{0}{65}{mark=*, mark size=2.6pt,
  mark options={draw=cinv, fill=white, line width=0.8pt}}
\rspts{1}{1}{65}{mark=*, mark size=2.6pt,
  mark options={draw=cvis, fill=white, line width=0.8pt}}
\rspts{0}{0}{85}{mark=square*, mark size=2.4pt,
  mark options={draw=cinv, fill=white, line width=0.8pt}}
\rspts{0}{1}{85}{mark=square*, mark size=2.4pt,
  mark options={draw=cvis, fill=white, line width=0.8pt}}
% --- legend ---
\addlegendimage{only marks, mark=*, mark options={draw=cinv, fill=cinv}}
\addlegendentry{inviscid}
\addlegendimage{only marks, mark=*, mark options={draw=cvis, fill=cvis}}
\addlegendentry{viscous}
\addlegendimage{only marks, mark=*, mark options={draw=black, fill=black}}
\addlegendentry{filled: ignited}
\addlegendimage{only marks, mark=*, mark options={draw=black, fill=white}}
\addlegendentry{open: survivor}
\addlegendimage{only marks, mark=square*,
  mark options={draw=black, fill=white}}
\addlegendentry{square: production startup}
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
